full.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing a segment of the abdominal aorta. The intimal surface is severely damaged, featuring extensive atherosclerotic plaques, ulceration, calcification, and overlying thrombi. The wall displays characteristic changes of severe atherosclerosis with complex lesions. This pathologic appearance is typical of advanced atherosclerosis affecting a major blood vessel.

random.description: This is a gross pathology specimen of an aorta showing severe atherosclerosis. The intimal surface is extensively damaged with prominent ulceration, hemorrhage, and overlying thrombus formation. Numerous yellowish-white atheromatous plaques and calcified deposits are scattered across the vessel wall. These findings are characteristic of severe complicated atherosclerotic disease of the aorta.
